source.file: hsuanice_Session Fix - Split Items at Fade Edges.lua

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - New: Session Fix - Interchange Prep, one window that checks and fixes a session before Interchanger (Pro Tools / Nuendo / Cubase). - Removed: the five separate scripts (Edges Off Grid, Looped Source Items, Misaligned Crossfades, Overlap Items, Split Items at Fade Edges) - their checks are part of the new window. Re-assign shortcuts / toolbar buttons to the new script. - Requires ReaImGui and the hsuanice Library package.

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Change: each check shows a short coloured title and a one-line description; colour = impact on the sound in an editing session (red print / delete, orange big change, yellow small change, green sound unchanged, grey review only), with a legend above the list.

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Add: Mixed channels can be fixed - one track per channel count as played ("<track> mono / stereo / 4ch ..."); the group with the most items stays on the original track, fewer channels above, more below; folders stay intact. Runs after Channel mode. - Change: Off grid follows the project grid setting and shows the grid unit; edges 1 sample off the grid are snapped (inward to the next grid line). - Change: off-grid edges zoom to one grid step either side; Save report asks where to save; no fold arrow in the title bar. - Change: in the lists only the first column stretches; Track / Position / Take keep their width when a column is resized.

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Fix: list columns were squeezed and jumped back when resized; columns now keep their width and the list scrolls sideways when it is wider than the window. - Add: lists can be sorted - click a column header (up / down / original order); Shift+click selects a range in the order shown. - Fix: Fix on Fade shapes missed fades on hidden tracks / inside collapsed folders (only Fix All reached them); they are fixed now. - Change: Folders comes right after Hidden tracks; the title bar and its close button use the chosen font size. - Fix: a broken crossfade (fades not matching the overlap) could not get its shape and was set to an invalid value; it is now marked "fix Crossfades first" and left alone until Crossfades has fixed it. - Add: issues that need another check first (hidden tracks / collapsed folders, broken crossfades) show it in colour in front; fixing such a check alone asks to fix that first (Yes = first that, then this check).

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Add: Workflow cues (last check) - removes the #in / #out / #Glue cues that glue / render leave in WAV files, only for files inside the session folder, in place (same file, audio untouched); other cues, take markers and project markers stay. Asks first (cannot be undone with Undo). - Add: Scan shows a progress bar with Cancel instead of freezing REAPER, and the time of each check (the slowest are shown). - Add: Tiny items check - editing slivers under 2 frames for review; 2-pops (xx:59:58:00 or after the last audio) are recognized and left out. - Add: Tiny items - mark tail pops as 2-pop from the list, or write "2-pop" / "tail pop" in the Item Notes, so they are left out.

reapack.name: hsuanice_Match Room Tone of Joined Items.lua
reapack.desc: Match Room Tone of Joined Items - level-match the background noise of touching / crossfaded items (take volume)

version.name: 26.1026.1430pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Initial release: level-match the room tone of touching / crossfaded selected items by take volume (reference = the longest item with pauses); more than 12 dB off -> moved to a '<track> - RT mismatch' track; only groups fully in view.

version.name: 26.1026.1446pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Initial release: level-match the room tone of touching / crossfaded selected items by take volume (reference = the longest item with pauses); more than 12 dB off -> moved to a '<track> - RT mismatch' track; only groups fully in view. - Room tone is measured on the WHOLE source file (quietest 10 %), so movement in the trimmed pauses does not count; an item whose own part is more than 6 dB louder than its file's quietest is listed.

version.name: 26.1026.1456pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Initial release: level-match the room tone of touching / crossfaded selected items by take volume; more than 12 dB off -> moved to a '<track> - RT mismatch' track; only groups fully in view. - Room tone is measured on the WHOLE source file (quietest 10 %), so movement in the trimmed pauses does not count; an item whose own part is more than 6 dB louder than its file's quietest is listed. - Spectrum check: the room tone's 1/3-octave spectrum (63 Hz - 6.3 kHz, level removed) is compared with the group's median; a different room tone (generator, air conditioning, another room: one band > 8 dB or > 3 dB on average off) is not level-matched but moved to the mismatch track, with the band named (e.g. '+14 dB around 100 Hz'). Two items that differ are both listed and left alone. The reference is chosen among the matching items.

version.name: 26.1026.1501pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Initial release: level-match the room tone of touching / crossfaded selected items by take volume; more than 12 dB off -> moved to a '<track> - RT mismatch' track; only groups fully in view. - Room tone is measured on the WHOLE source file (quietest 10 %), so movement in the trimmed pauses does not count; an item whose own part is more than 6 dB louder than its file's quietest is listed. - Spectrum check: the room tone's 1/3-octave spectrum (63 Hz - 6.3 kHz, level removed) is compared with the group's median; a different room tone (generator, air conditioning, another room) is moved to the mismatch track with the band named. - Progress window (gfx) while analyzing; Esc / close cancels with nothing changed; all changes applied together at the end.

version.name: 26.1026.1503pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Initial release: level-match the room tone of touching / crossfaded selected items by take volume - however far apart the levels are; only groups fully in view. - Room tone is measured on the WHOLE source file (quietest 10 %), so movement in the trimmed pauses does not count; an item whose own part is more than 6 dB louder than its file's quietest is listed. - Spectrum check: the room tone's 1/3-octave spectrum (63 Hz - 6.3 kHz, level removed) is compared with the group's median; only a different room tone (generator, air conditioning, another room, or speech all the way through) is moved to a '<track> - RT mismatch' track, with the band named. A level difference alone never moves an item. - Progress window (gfx) while analyzing; Esc / close cancels with nothing changed; all changes applied together at the end.

version.name: 26.1026.1523pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Initial release: level-match the room tone of touching / crossfaded selected items by take volume - however far apart the levels are; only groups fully in view. - Room tone is measured on the WHOLE source file (quietest 10 %), so movement in the trimmed pauses does not count; an item whose own part is more than 6 dB louder than its file's quietest is listed. Items that play the same file share one analysis. - Spectrum check: the room tone's 1/3-octave spectrum (63 Hz - 6.3 kHz, level removed) is compared with the group's median; only a different room tone (generator, air conditioning, another room, or speech all the way through) is moved to a '<track> - RT mismatch' track, with the band named. - Progress window (gfx), updated between items; Esc / close cancels with nothing changed; all changes applied together at the end. - Fix: an item was left opened up across defer cycles while measuring - REAPER drew it stretched and its audio stopped reading ('nothing to measure', no volume change). Each item is now measured in one go; items that cannot be measured are listed with the reason.

version.name: 26.1026.1534pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Initial release: level-match the room tone of touching / crossfaded selected items by take volume - however far apart the levels are; only groups fully in view. - Room tone is measured on the WHOLE source file (quietest 10 %), so movement in the trimmed pauses does not count; an item whose own part is more than 6 dB louder than its file's quietest is listed. Items that play the same file share one analysis. - Spectrum check: the room tone's 1/3-octave spectrum (63 Hz - 6.3 kHz, level removed) is compared with the group's median; only a different room tone (generator, air conditioning, another room, or speech all the way through) is moved to a '<track> - RT mismatch' track, with the band named. - Progress window (gfx), one item per update; Esc / close cancels with nothing changed; all changes applied together at the end. - Fix: nothing was measured ('no audio to measure') since the progress window - REAPER's audio accessor reads nothing inside a Lua coroutine (probed on REAPER 7.83). The analysis no longer uses a coroutine.

version.name: 26.1025.1206pre1
version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Fix: linking now goes one way per change - item / razor changes the script makes itself no longer count as user changes, so they are not linked back (e.g. Option+double-click on the TCP to select all tracks: part D selected the items in the range, then part B shrank the track selection to the item tracks). - Correction: part D is ON (ENABLE_D = true). The 26.1023.1358pre1 note said it was turned off, but only the note changed; with this fix D is safe to keep on.
